summary: Measure bottlenecks first and optimize the dominant cause with regression checks.
intents: this endpoint got slow, find out why
reduce the p95 latency of our API
profile the build and make it faster

prerequisites: reproducible workload or user-visible performance symptom
profiling, tracing, metrics, or benchmark capability recommended
verify: A baseline measurement exists from before the change
The improvement is shown with repeated measurements and a significance test
A regression check guards the improvement
